targeting_context.target_title: Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
targeting_context.jd_text:
Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 OTE | Reports to Partnerships (partner GTM) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s enterprise growth depends on making a safety-centered AI product deployable through organizations that own executive relationships, delivery capacity, and industry process knowledge. This is not only a technical-enablement
remit; it is a repeatability problem.

The operating tension is speed of partner-led customer adoption versus consistency of architecture, security posture, product feedback, and responsible-use standards across many external delivery teams.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a product- and platform-led AI company organized around building reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. Its public-benefit corporation structure and safety orientation are material commercial context, not merely
brand language.

Claude is sold as an AI product for complex knowledge work, data analysis, coding, and business use. The company therefore needs to translate a general-purpose model platform into governed, useful enterprise workflows without becoming a
large bespoke-services organization.

Its dominant enterprise motion is hybrid: direct product/platform adoption supported by cloud, technology, and services partners that can extend deployment capacity and vertical expertise.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Anthropic is pursuing enterprise adoption while the frontier-model market is rapidly converging on similar claims around capability, coding, security, and business productivity. Differentiation must show up in deployability, trust, and
sustained customer outcomes rather than model access alone.

Claude for Enterprise packages security, compliance, and business-oriented capabilities alongside developer-facing offerings. That broadens the buying group from technical teams to security, IT, business leaders, and change-management
owners.

The practical pressure is to turn early deployments into repeatable adoption patterns. Decision rights must stay close enough to Product and Engineering to preserve standards, while partner-facing teams need enough authority to move real
customer programs forward.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Anthropic was founded by Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei. The company’s stated orientation combines AI research, safety, and commercial product development.

Likely core stakeholders include:
- Partnerships and GTM leadership, responsible for ecosystem coverage and partner economics.
- Product and Engineering, responsible for platform capabilities, deployment friction, and roadmap tradeoffs.
- Enterprise security, compliance, and policy functions, which shape acceptable customer architectures.
- Sales and customer-facing teams, which need clear technical ownership in complex accounts.
- Cloud, technology, and services partners, which influence route-to-market, delivery quality, and customer trust.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Anthropic positions Claude around safety, accuracy, and security, creating an architectural expectation that enterprise deployments are designed for more than prompt quality or prototype speed.

Claude supports work such as analyzing data, writing code, and solving complex business problems. This makes solution design inherently cross-functional: identity, data access, workflow integration, user adoption, governance, and evaluation
all shape production value.

Anthropic publishes enterprise deployment guidance that treats implementation as a staged program involving technical setup and organizational launch. That is a signal that adoption success is expected to include change management, not
simply provisioned access.

The platform story must work for both business teams and developers. Architecture teams therefore sit at the boundary between end-user experience, API-led implementation, operational controls, and reusable solution patterns.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic publicly maintains a partner network spanning cloud, technology, and services partners. This indicates that the ecosystem is an intentional distribution and delivery layer, rather than a peripheral referral channel.

Accenture publicly positions its Anthropic relationship around enterprise AI deployment, productivity, and new-product creation. That is evidence of a services-partner motion built around implementation value, not only resale.

The ecosystem opportunity is to convert partner expertise into repeatable assets:
- Joint industry and workflow solutions that make Claude easier to position and deploy.
- Technical enablement that allows partner teams to lead customer work without diluting Anthropic’s standards.
- Clear escalation paths for strategic architectures, product gaps, and security-sensitive deployments.
- Structured field feedback that distinguishes reusable platform needs from one-off client requests.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s visible investment in an enterprise plan, administrator guidance, adoption education, and a formal partner network signals a shift from access to operationalized enterprise use.

As enterprise buyers seek production value from generative AI, partners become a leverage point and a control point. Weak enablement can create inconsistent customer experiences; overly centralized support can constrain ecosystem scale.

The near-term urgency is to establish a technical partner motion that can increase deployment throughput while producing disciplined product feedback and durable reference patterns.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Scaling partner-facing technical organizations without turning every deployment into bespoke consulting.
- Designing repeatable enterprise AI architectures across data, security, identity, workflow, and adoption constraints.
- Enabling consultancies and technology partners through practical playbooks, assets, and technical education.
- Operating credibly with Product, Engineering, Sales, and partner executives in ambiguous growth environments.
- Converting deployment learnings into structured roadmap input and reusable field guidance.
- Balancing commercial momentum with responsible AI, security, and customer-governance expectations.
- Leading technical pre-sales teams through high-stakes, partner-influenced enterprise decisions.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Anthropic’s partner network makes technical consistency across external delivery teams a strategic scaling issue.
- Claude’s enterprise adoption guidance suggests the company recognizes that rollout requires both platform readiness and organizational change.
- The company’s safety and reliability positioning creates a differentiated bar for how partners architect and represent solutions.
- Accenture’s public deployment positioning offers a concrete example of the ecosystem moving beyond simple model access.
- The role sits where partner leverage, enterprise architecture, and product-learning loops meet.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only; candidate claims must come from the governed resume/proof graph.
